name: North Carolina A&T State University
note:
N.C. A&T is my first-choice university because I can picture myself becoming part of the Aggie community. Black community and student leadership already matter a lot in my life, and I want both to be part of my college experience.

As Student Council President, I plan school events, lead event committees, and help staff when needed. I also lead the National Independent Black Student Union, where I help bring students together. A&T’s Student Government Association interests me because I want to keep learning how to represent other students and contribute to campus life.

I also want to grow as an entrepreneur and find people to build ideas with. I founded AVNT, a project management, marketing, and hiring agency, and build tools for its operations. That work connects my interest in business with the people and technology behind it. At A&T, I hope to keep exploring those interests while contributing to a community I would be proud to join.
heading: Why A&T feels personal to me.
